name: kawaiipantsu/bbs
description: THUGS(red) BBS - a web-based ANSI/ASCII bulletin board system with a CRT terminal UI

suggest.ext-redis: Faster session cache and chat pub/sub (falls back to DB/polling without it)

//: No third-party runtime deps. Beanstalkd, Redis and Discord clients are hand-rolled in app/src/Core. 'composer install' is optional and only regenerates the PSR-4 autoloader; app/bootstrap.php ships its own.
